title: Just launched Season 2 of my card game [Mystic Realms] developed with AI
author: cap45
selftext:
Artwork is a mix of Gen AI and Hand Drawn. Localization is also Gen AI. Surpised how well the localization has worked. Not perfect and it's clearly labeled as such in game, but lots of people playing in other languages. Played around with using Gen Ai for bot battles too. Had it working really well and the bots were really competive. Unfortunately they just took too long to make their turns for it to be use-able.   
  
If I ever make some money from it, I'd love to hire some artists, but it's been great to develop something I wouldn't have to money to create otherwise. If anyone's any questions.   
[https://apps.apple.com/app/mystic-realms-ccg/id6749706033](https://apps.apple.com/app/mystic-realms-ccg/id6749706033)  
[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.superpunch.sidhe&hl=en\_GB](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.superpunch.sidhe&hl=en_GB)

comments.author: Crawling_Hustler
comments.body:
Wow, Just wow. So, with handwork and AI art , u managed to make consistent looking art ? 

So far, that is what i have found most difficult. AI art keeps changing into different style each time

replies.author: poponis
replies.body: This is what I admired, too. Not ony AI art is inconsistent, but it is uninspired. It is OK for background images, terrains, fires, plants, etc, but when it comes to characters, they are dull and boring.

comments.author: poponis
comments.body:
I like the artwork a lot! It looks very original.
So, you sketched /draw the characters and then you improved them with AI? Could you describe your workflow?

comments.body: I've checked it, and it's really great. What generative AI model did you use to create artwork like this?
